entities.summary: Ethiopian, a notable figure in the history of Somalia, associated with Post-Ajuran Somali States (1700–1910). Preceded by Geledi Sultanate and Majeerteen Sultanate. Their legacy influenced Somali Clan Dynamics Pre-Colonial.
